hook.text: You search for 'running shoes' and the database returns results for 'run', 'runner', and 'shoes' too.

buildup.text: Full-text search uses inverted indexes: a mapping from every word to the documents that contain it.

discovery.text: Elasticsearch and PostgreSQL's tsvector tokenize text, apply stemming, and rank results by relevance.

twist.text: Inverted indexes are huge and expensive to update. Real-time search on rapidly changing data is hard.

climax.text: LIKE '%shoes%' scans every row. Full-text search with an inverted index returns results in milliseconds.

punchline.text: Inverted indexes make text search instant.

quiz.question: What data structure powers full-text search?
options: Inverted indexes mapping words to documents
